metadata.comment: ConfirmCredit -> INDETERMINATE (ADR-PC-032 / feature-design money-movement-settlement §10; ADR-IC-012 §P5). The network dropped after the credit was sent, so the ACL cannot yet confirm whether the Core executed it. Higher-priority mapping; fires when the request body contains the marker 'indeterminate', letting a dev/demo drive the settlement saga into AWAIT_CREDIT_CLEARANCE without a second stub. The signal is HTTP 202 Accepted -- an EXPLICIT indeterminate, distinct from a 2xx-success confirm (credits-success), a 4xx refusal, or a 5xx/timeout transient. The dispatcher classifies 202 on a ConfirmCredit as Indeterminate and the bridge synthesizes CreditIndeterminate (ADR-IC-003 §P4: a first-class wait, never a blind retry; the credit non-confirm enters clearance, NEVER silent). Mirrors debits-indeterminate.json on the credit surface.
